tippecc_data:TIPPECC_NorESM2-LM_day_r1i1.tippecc_data:comment: Aridity index is the ratio of precipitation to potential evapotranspiration. It is a measure of the degree of dryness of the climate at a given location. A value of 1 indicates that precipitation is equal to potential evapotranspiration, values greater than 1 indicate that precipitation is greater than potential evapotranspiration, and values less than 1 indicate that precipitation is less than potential evapotranspiration.
